name: Standing Recovery Breath

instructions.description: Stand with feet hip width apart and rest your hands on your lower ribs or hips.
Soften the knees and let the shoulders drop away from the ears.
Take a gentle inhale through the nose and a slow controlled exhale through the mouth or nose.
Continue until breathing feels steadier and more relaxed.

performanceMetrics.notes: Useful between exercise intervals or after exertion.

variationSuggestions.variationDescription: Pair slow breathing with easy walking during active recovery.

commentsNotes: Do not bend forward sharply if it makes breathing feel restricted.
Stay still if balance feels unsteady after exercise.
